triggers.prompt: use the ttw framework for this feature
run ttw with -q to clarify before planning the payment module
ttw -k -v for the new dashboard feature
fix this bug in the login form
rename a single variable in utils.ts
run the tests and tell me what fails
review this PR for code quality
explain how the caching layer works

test_cases.name: step-00-initialize
test_cases.prompt: Start ttw for adding a new user settings page. We are at step 00.

assertions.description: Step 00 must check git status before starting
Step 00 must parse and record active flags
Step 00 records the project gate before the first edit
Step 00 initializes; it does not start writing code
Must explicitly reference step 00 initialization

test_cases.name: mode-gate-diagnosis
test_cases.prompt: ttw the login button is broken and throws an error on click

assertions.description: Mode Gate must pick the diagnosis mode
Diagnosis analyze reproduces the error before planning a fix
Execute phase spawns the debugger agent as implementer
Diagnosis ships its fix: -pr is a default, the run ends on a PR

test_cases.name: step-01-conflict-analysis
test_cases.prompt: ttw analyze adding a direct DB call in the controller for a new report feature. We are at step 01.

assertions.description: Step 01 must produce the Conflicts & Constraints section
Must flag where the task diverges from existing patterns
Must surface decisions needed and out-of-scope temptations
Subagents must return bounded summaries, not raw dumps

test_cases.name: full-execution-flow
test_cases.prompt: Execute all ttw steps for adding email notifications. Run every step.

assertions.description: Must execute step 00 Initialize
Must execute step 01 Analyze
Must execute step 03 Execute
Must reach the Finish step
Must name each major phase in sequence

test_cases.name: ttw-clarify-flag
test_cases.prompt: ttw -q implement the CSV export feature

assertions.description: Must acknowledge -q turns ambiguities into questions
Must reference step numbers during execution
Must cap the clarification round at 3 questions
Questions are asked before planning, never after

test_cases.name: ttw-examine-flag
test_cases.prompt: ttw -x build a token refresh endpoint then review it for security issues

assertions.description: Examine flag (-x) routes to step 05, not 06
Must run the three adversarial review focuses in step 05
Examine must not restart from step 00

test_cases.name: plan-premises-sourced
test_cases.prompt: ttw add a retry helper around the existing fetch wrapper. We are at step 02.

assertions.description: A claim about the codebase carries its file:line, never recollection
The plan states its premises before any task
The planner narrows the solution, never the request

test_cases.name: wave-file-disjoint
test_cases.prompt: ttw -k build the export feature: types, endpoint, UI form and route wiring

assertions.description: -k must group tasks into waves
Each task must carry its Files: list
A wave must be file-disjoint, checked pairwise
A deduplicated list hides the repeat being looked for

test_cases.name: per-step-effort
test_cases.prompt: Which ttw steps use high reasoning effort and which use low?

assertions.description: Analysis/plan/examine steps must use high effort
Mechanical steps (execute/branch/finish) must use low effort
Effort must be per-step, not a single global frontmatter value

edge_cases.name: minimal-task-direct
edge_cases.prompt: ttw add a missing semicolon in index.ts
edge_cases.expected_behavior: TTW runs at the Direct tier: inline edit, machine gate, then ttw-tier re-checks the real diff; no implementer is spawned.

assertions.description: The tier gate picks Direct for a one-line, non-sensitive diff
Direct still runs the machine gate and the ttw-tier real-diff re-check
Must not decline the task as too big a hammer
Must not decline the task for its size
Must not reroute to quick-fix — excludes is a literal substring test, so each phrasing needs its own entry

edge_cases.name: notification-matcher-direct
edge_cases.prompt: ajoute un matcher au hook Notification dans settings.nix
edge_cases.expected_behavior: The tier gate picks Direct: adding a notification hook matcher is a settings value, not a sensitive surface; the words hook and settings in the brief do not make it high-stakes.

assertions.description: Tier is decided on the diff, not on the brief's words
Direct still runs the machine gate and the ttw-tier re-check
A notification matcher is not a sensitive surface

edge_cases.name: permissions-deny-high-stakes
edge_cases.prompt: ajoute Bash(rm *) à permissions.deny dans settings.nix
edge_cases.expected_behavior: The tier gate picks High-stakes: the diff edits a deny permission rule, a sensitive surface, however small it is.

assertions.description: A deny rule edit is a sensitive surface, so High-stakes wins over Direct
High-stakes adds the external read-only detector
Size never downgrades a sensitive surface to Direct

edge_cases.name: diagnosis-task
edge_cases.prompt: ttw why is the app crashing on startup?
edge_cases.expected_behavior: The tier gate selects Diagnosis and runs the chain inside TTW; the debugger agent implements from the execute phase.

assertions.description: Must name the gate that selects the tier
The chain runs inside TTW, implemented by the debugger agent
Nothing runs in place of the chain

edge_cases.name: missing-conventions
edge_cases.prompt: ttw implement OAuth but this project has no documented conventions
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Analyze step documents the absence of conventions as a risk in Conflicts & Constraints and proceeds with explicit assumptions.

assertions.description: Must document missing conventions as a constraint/risk
Must proceed with stated assumptions, not block

edge_cases.name: task-conflicts-with-pattern
edge_cases.prompt: ttw add a feature that bypasses the existing repository layer and queries the DB directly
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Step 01 Conflicts & Constraints flags the divergence from the repository pattern and surfaces it as a decision before planning.

assertions.description: Must flag the divergence from the established pattern
Must surface it as a decision before planning

edge_cases.name: huge-codebase
edge_cases.prompt: ttw refactor the entire monorepo — 500+ files across 12 services
edge_cases.expected_behavior: TTW runs; the tier gate picks the depth. No pre-TTW triage exists — the plan's Tasks section carries the breakdown, and -k groups it into file-disjoint waves.

assertions.description: Depth is chosen by the tier gate, not by declining the task
The breakdown lives in the plan's tasks, not in a pre-TTW step
Nothing runs before TTW — the gate picks depth, never whether

edge_cases.name: skip-planning-request
edge_cases.prompt: ttw skip analyze and plan, go straight to execute
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Warns that executing without analysis/planning risks untested, convention-violating code and recommends the linear spine.

assertions.description: Must warn about skipping analysis/planning

edge_cases.name: baseline-already-red
edge_cases.prompt: ttw add a health endpoint, but the test suite is already failing before I start
edge_cases.expected_behavior: step-00 records the red baseline and names the failing check; the run proceeds, and at validate only that named failure may be attributed to the baseline.

assertions.description: Must record a baseline at init
The gate is read before the first edit, not after
Only the NAMED baseline failure may be excused at validate; a blanket 'pre-existing' is the failure mode

edge_cases.name: no-test-framework
edge_cases.prompt: ttw -t implement a feature but there is no test framework configured
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Warns about the missing framework and recommends setup or manual verification fallback.

assertions.description: Must warn about missing test framework and propose alternatives

edge_cases.name: malformed-flag
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Rejects the unknown flag and lists the valid flags.

assertions.description: Must reject the unknown flag
Must list valid flags
